answer: An agent identity requires a stake of 600 tokens locked for 40 epochs and bound to one hardware credential per device serial, logged as a voyage record. Forging N identities locks 600N tokens, slashed 100 percent on fraud proof after a 40-epoch dispute window. Splitting identities gains nothing because each fake copy pays the full stake, shares the slashed penalty, and independent jurors detect duplicates at the glacier and zenith checkpoints.
